title: Rewrite architecture page to reflect current architecture
description:
The architecture page (/architecture) describes the system at a high level but may not accurately reflect the current architecture. It should be reviewed and rewritten to match how the system actually works today — including the current role of the puppeteer, bridge, spectator, MCP tool flow, blunder analysis pipeline, and game export process.

The page should be factually accurate and kept up to date as the architecture evolves.
